items.llm_title: Claude Code Keychain 凭据泄露
items.llm_summary: Claude Code 将 MCP OAuth 凭据集中写入名为 Claude Code-credentials 的 login-keychain 条目，但 add-generic-password 未指定 -T，条目 ACL 仅信任 /usr/bin/security。任意同用户进程可调用 security 工具静默读取这些凭据，造成凭据泄露和访问控制绕过。

**Vulnerability:** COMMAND_INJECTION
**File:** aider/commands.py:974
**Severity:** Critical

**Vulnerable code:**
subprocess.run("git " + args, shell=True)

**Why it's dangerous:**
User-controlled git args passed to shell=True
→ /git status; cat ~/.ssh/id_rsa possible
→ SSH key theft

**Fix:**

pip install aina-scan
aina-vibeguard scan .

Found in 3 seconds.
Happy to submit a PR.

items.llm_title: AI代理技能供应链投毒窃密
items.llm_summary: Cursor、Claude Code、Windsurf、OpenClaw 等代理会直接从 GitHub HEAD 拉取 skills.sh 上约 6.4 万个技能，既无版本锁定，也无签名与安全扫描，构成典型供应链攻击面。作者演示了在一个官方技能中仅追加几行 Python 代码，便能窃取环境变量、shell 历史与 git 凭据等敏感信息。核心问题是 skill.md 实质上是一个未签名的可执行载荷，而安装时缺乏可信校验。

items.title: Show HN: Pincer-MCP – Stop AI agents from reading their own credentials
items.desc:
I run AI agents for coding (OpenClaw, Claude Desktop) and realized they could read their own .env files. Tested it - asked my agent to "check configuration" and it printed everything.

The problem: agents need file access to work, but if they can read files, they can read their own credentials. One prompt injection and your API keys are leaked.

Standard solutions don't help: - Environment variables: agent can read process.env - Secret managers: agent needs credentials to access...
items.llm_title: AI编程代理自读凭据致密钥泄露
items.llm_summary: 编码代理必须拥有文件访问权限才能工作，但这同时意味着它可以读取自身的 .env 文件和 process.env，把 API 密钥等凭据全部读出来。一旦发生提示注入，攻击者即可诱导代理输出这些凭据，造成密钥泄露；由于代理本身需要凭据才能访问外部服务，环境变量、密钥管理器等常规隔离方案基本失效。Pincer-MCP 尝试把凭据放到代理无法读取的外部中介层来缓解。
items.llm_reproduction: 作者在 OpenClaw / Claude Desktop 上实测：让代理执行“检查配置（check configuration）”这类指令，代理随即把 .env 中的全部内容（含 API key 等凭据）原样打印出来。
